SELECT 
	saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode, 
	date = dbo.saleledger.date,  
	invdiscperc = dbo.saleledger.discperc, 
	flatdisc = dbo.saleledger.flatdisc, 
	misccharges = dbo.saleledger.misccharges,
	invsalestax = dbo.saleledger.salestax,
	CustRefNo   = dbo.saleledger.CustRefNo,
	Remarks   = dbo.saleledger.Remarks,
	looseqty = dbo.saledetail.looseqty,
	bonusqty=dbo.saledetail.bonusqty,
	qty=saledetail.looseqty, 
	packing=case when dbo.item.packcode=null then space(30) else dbo.itempacking.name end,
	itemflatdisc=saledetail.itemflatdisc,
	packqty  = 0,  
	price = dbo.saledetail.saleprice,    
	itemdiscperc = dbo.saledetail.discperc,    
	packunits = dbo.saledetail.packunits,    
	batch = dbo.saledetail.batch,    
	expiry = dbo.saledetail.expiry,    
	SalesTax = ROUND(saledetail.LooseQty * (saledetail.SalePrice - saledetail.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - saledetail.DiscPerc * 0.01) * saledetail.GSTPerc * 0.01, 2) + ((saledetail.LooseQty + saledetail.Bonusqty) * saledetail.UnitSalesTax),
	itemname = item.name,
	datestring = Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(dd, saleledger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(mm, saleledger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(yy, saleledger.date)))), 
	Person = accounts.name,
	/* netrate=Round(((((saledetail.looseqty + (saledetail.packqty * saledetail.packunits)) * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) * (1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)))/(saledetail.packqty * saledetail.packunits + saledetail.looseqty) ,2),*/
	netrate=Round(((saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) ,2),
	purprice=Round(item.purprice / CASE WHEN item.packunits <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE item.packunits END, 2),
	/*margin=Round(((((((saledetail.looseqty + saledetail.packqty * saledetail.packunits) * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) * (1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) / (saledetail.packqty * saledetail.packunits + saledetail.looseqty)) - saledetail.avgprice) * 100) / saledetail.avgprice,2),		 */
	/*margin=Round(((((((saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (1 - .01 * saledetail.discperc)) * (1- .01 * saleledger.discperc)) - Round(saledetail.avgprice,2)) * 100) / Round(((saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) ,2)) ,2),*/
	margin=Round(((Round((((saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (1 - .01 * saledetail.discperc)) * (1- .01 * saleledger.discperc)) + ROUND(saledetail.LooseQty * (saledetail.SalePrice - saledetail.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - saledetail.DiscPerc * 0.01) * saledetail.GSTPerc * 0.01, 2) + ((saledetail.LooseQty + saledetail.Bonusqty) * saledetail.UnitSalesTax),2) - Round(saledetail.avgprice,2)) * 100) / CASE WHEN Round(((saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) + ROUND(saledetail.LooseQty * (saledetail.SalePrice - saledetail.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - saledetail.DiscPerc * 0.01) * saledetail.GSTPerc * 0.01, 2) + ((saledetail.LooseQty + saledetail.Bonusqty) * saledetail.UnitSalesTax),2) > 0 THEN Round(((saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) + ROUND(saledetail.LooseQty * (saledetail.SalePrice - saledetail.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - saledetail.DiscPerc * 0.01) * saledetail.GSTPerc * 0.01, 2) + ((saledetail.LooseQty + saledetail.Bonusqty) * saledetail.UnitSalesTax), 2) ELSE 1 END, 2) ,
	invtype=Case dbo.saleledger.salecatcode 	When 1 Then 'Cash' 	
														When 2 Then 'Credit' 
														When 3 Then 'Cash'
														End
FROM
	dbo.saleledger, 
	dbo.saledetail,    
	dbo.item LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.itempacking ON ( dbo.item.packcode = dbo.itempacking.packcode),
	dbo.accounts
	
WHERE
	:ai_one_or_all = 0 AND
	dbo.saleledger.date BETWEEN :ad_StartDate and :ad_EndDate  and
	dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (1, 2, 3) and
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode and  
	dbo.saledetail.icode = item.icode and 
	dbo.saleledger.custcode IN (:ar_custcode)and
	dbo.saleledger.custcode=accounts.acccode 
UNION ALL

objects.name: c_itemdiscount
objects.expression: /* Round(((( quantity *   price ) *  ( itemdiscperc *  .01 ) ) + (( quantity *   price )  *   ( 1 - (itemdiscperc *  .01 ) ) )  *  ( 0.01  *  invdiscperc)) , 2)  */

objects.name: c_totalmargin
objects.expression: Trim(String(Round((( c_totalsaleamount   -  c_totalavgamount )  *  100) / c_totalsaleamount ,2))) + '  % =  ' + Trim(String(Round( c_totalsaleamount   -  c_totalavgamount, 2)))

objects.name: c_totalsaleamount
objects.expression: Round ( Sum(  c_salevalue  for  all) - sum( flatdisc for all distinct  saleinvcode )  + sum(  misccharges for all distinct  saleinvcode)   , 0)

objects.name: c_invsaleamount
objects.expression: Round ( Sum(  c_salevalue  for group 1) -  flatdisc  +  misccharges   , 0)
